title: Learning off, from likes, or from demonstrations

start: You lead a band with your drums. The bass and keys follow your groove.
Play as in a jam: start a groove, stay with it for a few phrases (4 bars each), then change it.
When the bass plays something you want to hear again with this groove, tap pad 16 once, like a nod to the bass player. Keep your hands going.
If you want the bass to change, change your groove. You do not need a pad for that.
Try a few grooves: steady kicks on the beat, kicks that push ahead of the beat, a busy groove. Later, come back to a groove where you nodded, and listen whether the bass remembers.
To rest, stop drumming; the band keeps playing. Do not press Stop in Live.
condition: A new band. Play the same way: start a groove, nod (pad 16) when you like the bass, and come back to that groove later.
